summary: The perfect-pairing construction is new (Mathlib still lists it as a TODO), but the PR hand-proves two located Mathlib lemmas, leaves a pre-existing proof unrouted through the general finrank lemma it just added, adds an unused span specialization, and states double duality twice for a symmetric form.
